completion_mode: Primary-source related-work and bounded novelty integration into the editable workshop manuscript, with Crossref/arXiv/CFP identifier checks and a real compilation/citation check. Not a scored bake-off and not an end-to-end safety result.

criteria.criterion: Closest related systems and implementable baseline rationale are cited from primary sources.
criteria.explanation: related_work.md and related_work.bib compare assurance boundary, source fidelity, generated-code effect observation, and useful-work measurement for reference monitors, proof-carrying authorization, Catala/executable law, UCAN/Cedar/MCP, AgentSpec, Progent, CaMeL, AgentDojo, and workshop-neighbor coding/proof systems. Arm A0–A4 rationale is taken from those primary sources as mechanism classes in this stack, not imported suites. Identifier corrections: Cedar DOI 10.1145/3649835 / arXiv:2403.04651; Hamlen DOI 10.1145/1111596.1111601; Clover cited from arXiv:2310.17807 after a false FMCAD DOI was removed. Live CFP, MCP, UCAN, IPFS, libp2p, and Quack URLs were retrieved on 12 September 2026. No listed external system is a scored arm.

criteria.criterion: Novelty statement matches the bounded experimental contribution and acknowledges modeling/trust assumptions.
criteria.explanation: novelty_statement.md and the rewritten abstract, introduction, and conclusion state the selected ENFORCE sandbox-handler question, keep Legal IR as a lossy model, record OFF/in-memory/trust limits, and refuse first-system or superiority claims against AgentSpec, Progent, CaMeL, Catala, AgentDojo, and related systems. Empirical safety numbers are reserved until retained runs exist.

The compiled document has 9 main-text pages, references on pages 10–13, and appendices after that, as recorded in the pdflatex log and pdftotext extract. The binary PDF is omitted from the snapshot (NUL bytes); pdf_digest.json records its SHA-256 and page counts.
